checks: Checked original 5ef2792a4d153635 §6, final example, and its frozen source digest. The original uses precisely the same zero-area segment and retained thin triangle.

Every listed vertex is sampled when h is reciprocal to a positive integer. The only integer coarse levels are exposed endpoints, with exactly the given fibers. The segment from (0,-1,0) to (0,1,0) and the segment from (1,0,-1) to (1,0,1) lie in the hull and their four endpoints form a tetrahedron with nonzero determinant.

The triangle has height two and opposite-edge length 2h^2, so its area is 2h^2. Its section length at u is h^2(1+u); the singleton at -1 is counted as length zero. Summing on the symmetric grid of 2/h+1 points gives weighted fine mass h^2(2+h). The omitted segment has coarse area zero and precisely one fine level of length two, hence weighted mass 2h.

The retained block map fixes u and divides x by 2h^2. The resulting nondegenerate fixed triangle has positive inradius and finite outer radius, the absolute determinant is 1/(2h^2), and the one-dimensional fine radius is h/2. The omitted-to-retained coarse mass ratio equals 1/h. The retained fine fraction is h(2+h)/(h(2+h)+2), which tends to zero. These mass identities were replayed by exact rational sums.

overlap.comparison: Gives conditional retained-support recovery, with an explicit factor equal to the retained fine mass fraction. It does not show that zero coarse area can coexist with a dominant omitted fine contribution. This example tests the hypothesis without invoking the recovery bound.

Includes zero-volume sections in a general absolute discrepancy estimate and assumes small relative mesh for normalized convergence. The example has retained mass of order h^2 and original mesh of order h, so the relative error assumption is absent.

readability: Fixed round image means a fixed nondegenerate triangle with uniform inner and outer radii. The ratio 1/h uses retained coarse mass as denominator, while the final retained fraction uses total fine mass.
review_method: Independent mathematical proof review of the frozen normalized candidate
summary: The explicit full-dimensional sampled hull has an omitted zero-area coarse fiber whose sampled fine mass dominates the retained mass even in a dense retained block frame.
